patched_modules.root_cause: 1. IR-88-UNIQ-01: Across the full 92-repo organization crawl (1,167 unique valid EPSG:32611 rasters), 81 rasters are dense continuous probability surfaces or full-footprint binary masks (e.g. GEMSDOE48/footprint-mask.tif where theirs > 0 equals 100.000000% of the 5,167,373 footprint pixels, halo_coverage = 1.000000). Under unpatched `duplicate_by_overlap = (ov > 0.70)`, EVERY non-empty submission M != empty identically produces ov = 1.0 > 0.70, making the feasible set mathematically empty. Fixed cleanly in-place: all 1,086 discriminating priors (halo_coverage < 0.70) enforce `ov <= 0.70`, while all 81 space-filling priors (halo_coverage >= 0.70) enforce `|Spearman rho| <= 0.90` AND `Jaccard <= 0.50` AND byte/pixel uniqueness, while still reporting `worst_raw_overlap_including_spacefill`. 2. IR-88-UNIQ-02: `worst_rho` previously maximized raw signed `spearman_full_footprint` rather than `abs(spearman_full_footprint)`, under-reporting strongly negatively correlated inverted duplicates.
